results.name: Bailey Bridge DD type
results.description:
Model of a panel bridge with wooden deck, Bailey type DD based on M2 version.

The model of the bridge is consisted of three objects, the Male Ramp, the Bay section and the Female Ramp. All of them are “Children” of the Empty DD_StartPoint.

The placement of the bridge starts allways from the Male Ramp and then follows the 10 feet Bay section, wich it has an Array Modifier so you can increases the span 10ft each time.

The DD type can reach 180ft span, so every 10 feet there is a corresponding empty for Female Ramp to be attached.

Ramps are two type single length and double lenght.

results.name: Industrial Stunt Ramp | Racing & Drift Game Prop
results.description:
**Industrial Stunt Ramp designed as a game-ready environment prop for racing, drifting, stunt and off-road games.**

The ramp features a weathered galvanized metal surface, rusty yellow/orange steel borders and painted red directional chevrons. The worn materials and dirt details are designed to give the asset a used industrial / street-racing appearance.

FEATURES:

WORKFLOW:

results.name: Hard Surface Model
results.description:
https://youtu.be/6mrw7U43Beo

After watching the above video, I wasn't impressed on how it didn't utilize the power of Houdini. My version uses a ramp in vex to blend the middle piece but also making sure the topology on the ends was as clean as possible.

This is technically, the topo rebuilt version, nothing too major, a few points moved, and a few polys deleted/ added, after the design was finalized. 

Added a simple procedural metal texture.

results.name: car service ramp
results.description: The car service ramp model is a compact metal device that allows you to raise the front or rear of a vehicle to a small height to facilitate repairs and underbody inspections, especially in conditions where an inspection pit is not available. It consists of two inclined platforms and is designed for use in garages, auto repair shops, or outdoors
